scope: Focused whole-heart surface priority follow-up for Probe and TEE
newCases: Pause during actual gzip decompression holds geometry until Reconstruction resumes
Pause during a decoded read stops further chunk consumption and preserves the decoded prefix
Worker completion immediately before switching workspace starts neither cleanup nor GPU installation
Completed cleanup flags remain resident while GPU installation waits for Reconstruction
Leaving during cleanup aborts that stage and resumes it without another geometry download
Canceling a workspace-paused selection removes waiters and prevents later resurrection
An aborted cleanup signal prevents initial transport and continuation after metadata
An aborted pending flag read cancels its reader before validation
preserved: Original welded geometry and index validation
Original debris source identity and triangle-uniformity validation
Stale selection cancellation and fallback to the previous complete view
limits: Node worker-stream fixtures and a LinkeDOM/mock-GPU lifecycle test establish scheduling and cancellation semantics. They do not measure public-network performance or browser frame rate. Already-running hash operations and bounded stream internals can finish while paused, but cannot advance to GPU installation.
